caveats: Illustrative workload envelopes, not measured accuracy, throughput or latency.
Deep reviews are additional work on a subset of quick reviews, not extra unique claims.
Token counts include all calls, source reading and hidden reasoning; retries consume the same budget.
Contributor allows training on requests and requires appropriate content rights and disclosures.
Native search query counts are assumptions until enforceable limits are verified.
Infrastructure is an allowance for hosting, storage, CPU, OCR, logs, bandwidth and notifications, not a vendor quote.
Platform license fees remain unknown until explicitly supplied. Tax, labor and development are excluded.
No free credits, batch discounts or prompt-cache discounts are assumed.
The calculator does not execute checks, enforce provider billing limits, or forecast feed coverage.
